# Inspire Business Group

You envision it. We build it.

> Inspire Business Group LLC designs and builds websites, apps and brand identity, including logo design, for small businesses across the US. We work remotely. Every project starts with a free consultation.

## Services

- **Web design**: a website for your business, designed and built for you.
- **App development**: an app for your business or your customers, designed and built for you.
- **Brand identity (logo design)**: a logo package (logo design on its own) or a full brand identity (your logo plus the rest of your brand).

## Who it is for

Small businesses anywhere in the US.

## How a project runs

1. Free consultation
2. Proposal & fixed quote
3. Design
4. Build
5. Launch & handoff

## Mission

The only thing between you and your dream is the technology in between. Let us build it.

## Products we build ourselves

- Forge: AI-powered exam prep for high-stakes certifications, starting with CISSP.
- Fluyo: AI-powered language learning with conversational AI and real-world practice.
- [Smart Home Certification](https://atomshott.com/): A framework for certifying homes by their level of smart-technology integration.

## Team

Page: https://www.inspirebusinesstechnology.com/team

The people who handle a project from the first request through launch.

- Marlon Gibson, Founder & CEO.
- Adriana Solano, Chief of Operations: Turns a request into a sequenced plan, assigns owners, and keeps the work moving through launch.
- Catalina Moreno, Software Architect: Designs the system before production code is written, so the build has clear bounds.
- Valentina Cruz, Coding Engineer: Implements the backend, frontend, and database work the architecture calls for.
- Renata Vega, Infrastructure / DevOps Engineer: Makes builds, hosting, and launches repeatable.
- Camila Reyes, UX Design Engineer: Designs how the product should feel to use, from the first visit through handoff.
- Daniela Vargas, Web Designer: Designs and builds the pages and visual system customers see.
- Natalia Ortega, Security Engineer: Finds what can be abused before a release ships.
- Aria Chen, Cybersecurity Engineer: Reviews security posture and hardening.
- Alexandra Chen, Cybersecurity Engineer: Assesses risk and guides security controls.
- Elena Castillo, Quality Auditor: Inspects work before it ships and reports what passed, what failed, and what to fix.
- Julieta Herrera, Privacy & Compliance Auditor: Checks numbers, privacy, and compliance before something goes public.
- Isabella Navarro, Marketing Engineer: Shapes the offer so a first-time visitor understands it and knows what to do next.
- Fernanda Ortiz, Social Media Engineer: Turns the story into posts that fit each channel.
- Gabriela Mendoza, Research Engineer: Turns open questions into sourced findings before the team builds.
- Bianca Morales, Administrative Assistant: Keeps scheduling, follow-ups, and project details in order.
- Marisol Reyes, Audio / Video Engineer: Plans and produces product and explainer audio and video.

## FAQ

- What does Inspire Business Group do? We design and build websites and apps, and we create brand identities, from a logo package to a full brand identity.
- Who do you work with? Small businesses across the US.
- How does a project start? Send a request with the form on the site, or email info@inspirebusinesstechnology.com. Every project starts with a free consultation, followed by a proposal with a fixed quote, then design, build, and launch and handoff.
- Where do you work? We work remotely with small businesses anywhere in the US.
- Can I ask for more than one service? Yes. In the request form you can choose a website, an app, brand identity, or any mix.
